meta.purpose: Golden fixtures for the lead-scoring boundary used to support Backend-owner T032/T033. Inputs follow the spec §7.4 LeadContext (agreed D2 signals; no raw PII in expected output; phone numbers deliberately absent). expectedOutput is the EXACT deterministic result of createAiService({ AI_MODE: 'mock' }).scoreLead(context). Scoring computes and returns only — no persistence. Backend owner: use these as expected bodies when exercising scoreLead (compute-on-demand fallback) in supertest/integration tests running in AI_MODE=mock.
